card.name: Words just before 'agent(s)' or 'drugs'
card.fires_on: The word right before a noun like agent, agents or drugs, especially the end of antibacterial, antipsychotic or antidepressant, or 'central' before 'figure'.

modes.label: Drug-class adjective
modes.description: Final piece of a drug-class adjective that is followed by agents or drugs.
modes.example: nearly all antib<<acterial>> agents, including clindamycin hydro

modes.label: Linking word before a noun
modes.description: A short word like 'the' or 'central' where a noun such as agent or figure is expected next.
modes.example: has been the<< central>> figure in the civilized world

card.writes: It suppresses the -ent/-ents endings and promotes the word agent(s), so the next word is likely agent or agents.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'agent' or 'agents', as in 'antibacterial agents'.
